# Formcrafts

Formcrafts is an online form builder for collecting responses, managing forms, and accessing uploaded files across an organization.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/formcrafts/.

## Actions

- **Download File** (read-only): Download an uploaded Formcrafts file by file ID and return an offloaded file reference.
- **Get Form** (read-only): Get a Formcrafts form's metadata, response count, fields, and pages by form ID.
- **List Files** (read-only): Return one page of files uploaded to the connected Formcrafts organization.
- **List Form Responses** (read-only): Return one page of live responses for a Formcrafts form, including visitor metadata, workflow results, and typed field values.
- **List Forms** (read-only): Return one page of forms from the connected Formcrafts organization.
- **List Workspaces** (read-only): Return one page of workspaces from the connected Formcrafts organization.
